summary: Modern ground floor flat · Unfurnished · Available August 2024 · Great West Jesmond location
description:
A modern two bedroom Tyneside flat in a superb West Jesmond location.

My Property Box are delighted to offer to the Lettings market this groundfloor flat on Lavender Gardens, West Jesmond.

Having recently undergone extensive refurbishment works, the flat briefly comprises; entrance hallway, large living room, contemporary kitchen, two double bedrooms and shower room. Positioned ion the heart of West Jesmond, the property provides excellent access to local amenities & transport links. Local shops and cafes at Brentwood Avenue are only a stones throw away, as well as West Jesmond Metro. Newcastle City Centre and both university campuses are also only a stones throw away.

Available 16/08/2024, unfurnished. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
